strings.تشطيبات الكويت: شلون تعتمد لوحة خامات مو: Home finishing in Kuwait: approving a coordinated material palette
strings.تختار صبغ يعجبك، وبعده كسوة جميلة، لكن ل: You choose a paint that you like, and then a beautiful cladding, but why do they feel the house is not connected? The practical solution starts with a single materials board for the project, with a record of where each choice is made. This method helps you see the finishes of the house as a whole before approving the supply and implementation. If you plan to finish in Kuwait, discuss with Almusaileem Paints & Decor a consistent collection that suits your rooms and use, within the services that the place really needs.
strings.تصميم توضيحي للوحة خامات تضم خشباً مسطحا: Illustrative design of a materials board that includes flat wood, stone, marble and light paint samples
strings.تصميم توضيحي مولّد بالذكاء الاصطناعي، ول: AI-generated illustration, not a photograph of a completed Almusaileem project.
strings.ابدأ بسجل الغرف والأسطح: Start with the log rooms and roofs.
strings.اكتب اسم كل غرفة، ثم الجدران والسقف والع: Type the name of each room, then the walls, ceiling and elements remaining in it. Select for each surface: existing and will remain, or is required to be renewed, or a deferred decision. Then record the proposed finishing instead of repeating the word "decor" in each entry. The presence of the record prevents the adoption of a material for the hall and forget about its impact on the corridor open to it.
strings.في مثال افتراضي، يمكن أن يكون لون الجدرا: In a hypothetical example, the basic color of the walls can be shared between the lounge and the corridor, with specific cladding for one wall and different textures for the bedroom. The idea is not to unify every detail; it is required to know where the color repeats and where the difference begins, so that each choice has a clear reason.
strings.شنو تحط في لوحة الخامات؟: What do you land on the materials board?
strings.عينة لون الجدار مع اسم المنتج ورمز اللون: Wall color sample with product name, color code and gloss degree.
strings.قطعة أو عينة تعريفية للكسوة المقترحة، مع: A piece or sample identifying the proposed cladding, with its name and reference at the supplier.
strings.صورة واضحة أو عينة من الأرضية والأبواب ا: Clear image or sample of the floor and doors on which the format will be built.
strings.ملاحظة عن اتجاه النقش أو العروق، ونهاية: Note on the direction of the inscription or veins, and the end of the material at the edges.
strings.خلّ العينات قابلة للتعريف، فلا يكفي إرسا: Sample vinegar is identifiable. It is not enough to send a photo with the name “Bigg II”. Give each selection a simple code in the record, and keep the picture of the board and its revision date. If a key element changes, check the neighboring elements before installing the new resolution.
strings.اختبر المجموعة داخل البيت: Test the group inside the house
strings.شوف العينات في الغرفة المعنية نهارًا ومس: See samples in the room concerned day and evening, and next to which materials will remain. Recommends
strings.بتجربة الطلاء على الجدار ورؤيته تحت إضاء: By experimenting with paint on the wall and seeing it under different illuminations to get a more accurate perception. So phone images are useful for discussion, but they are not an ultimate reference for color matching.
strings.لا تحكم على اللمعة من عينة لون مطبوعة وح: Do not judge the luster from a printed color sample alone. Ask for a sample that represents the product and the proposed finish as much as possible, and for the expected difference in result due to surface texture or surface. See selection from sitting place and corridor, not just at close range.
strings.بعد المقارنة، اكتب ما تم اعتماده وما بقي: After comparison, write down what has been approved and what remains to be chosen. Link each sample to the room and the intended surface, and select the decision-maker in the family so as not to reach the outlet conflicting instructions. The adoption of aesthetics does not require a review of the suitability of the material for the surface and how it is used and processed.
strings.إذا تعذرت خامة، اطلب عرض البديل بعينته و: If a material is not available, ask for the alternative’s sample and data before supplying. See the substitution effect on color, texture, ends and agreed items. The phrase “almost the same shape” does not count as approval of a different product, especially if the material connects more than one room.
